name: my-18--grok-4-7
question: What income tax rate do Malaysian small and medium companies pay on the first RM150,000 of chargeable income?
answer:
Malaysian small and medium companies (with paid-up capital not exceeding RM2.5 million) pay 17% income tax on the first RM150,000 of chargeable income. The remaining income is taxed at 24%.
